description: This file defines the Wraps class and its interface, which serves as a stub or mock for system-level functions used in the project. It includes virtual methods for system calls and static methods to access the implementation.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: An abstract class defining the interface for system function mocks, with virtual destructor and virtual methods for system operations.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: A class providing static access to system function implementations, holds a static pointer to WrapsImpl, and provides methods that delegate calls to the implementation.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation instance for Wraps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton Wraps instance.

methods.name: system
methods.description: Executes a system command via the implementation.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Opens a process by creating a pipe, via the implementation.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Logs a message with a priority, using the implementation.

methods.name: getmntent
methods.description: Reads the next mount entry from the file.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Securely opens a process with variable arguments.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Executes a secure system command with variable arguments.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Reads the value of a symbolic link.
